scientific_question: Does the exact >=200x rank allocation already exclude the terminal expert output/JVP write subspaces, or did the learned nonlinear dictionary fail because it could not identify feature-side nonlinear coordinates?

theory.diagnosis: The learned nonlinear dictionaries reduced discovery output MSE but did not reduce JVP loss and generalized poorly, while fixed task-metric KFAC structure remained stable near 0.70 recovery. Before another architecture is trained, isolate the necessary write-space condition with an algebraic projection audit.
theory.necessary_condition: A complete rank-r GELU dictionary writes both its output and input-JVP into the span of its r write vectors. Orthogonal projection of the dense teacher actions into the best allowed write span is therefore an optimistic ceiling that removes all feature-map and optimizer errors.

three_outcomes.same_split_ceiling_fails: The registered rank/sharing topology lacks write capacity even with heldout leakage; it cannot pass as a complete dictionary at this budget.
three_outcomes.same_split_passes_but_causal_fails: A sufficient write span exists but is not stable across routed data banks; a causal metric/community prior is required before feature learning.
three_outcomes.causal_ceiling_passes: Write capacity and identification are sufficient; the rejected learned dictionary localizes the remaining failure to nonlinear feature/gating identification and JVP matching.

theory.not_a_model_sweep: No trainable candidate, optimizer, learning rate, checkpoint, or architecture is selected. The audit measures fixed algebraic bounds at exactly the three preregistered topology ranks and reports descriptive minimum-rank lower bounds.

global_shared_rank619.sharing: one write subspace shared across all selected layers and experts

layer_shared_rank60.sharing: one write subspace per layer shared across its experts

expert_local_rank7.sharing: one private write subspace per layer/expert

data_protocol.sampling: Use exact terminal top-2 routing and deterministic per-expert samples independently in discovery A, discovery B, and heldout. Heldout samples never affect causal bases or thresholds.

basis_protocol.joint_metric: For every sharing group, eigendecompose C = Y^T Y + 0.10 * J^T J in float64, where Y is the dense complete-expert action and J its analytic input-JVP. Use the leading registered-rank eigenvectors as the shared write basis.
basis_protocol.causal_bases: Fit discovery A and B bases independently and project untouched heldout routed actions/JVPs.
basis_protocol.same_split_ceiling: Fit a heldout basis on heldout actions and evaluate the same heldout actions. This intentionally leaking number is only an optimistic representational ceiling and cannot authorize training by itself.
basis_protocol.optimistic_marginal_bounds: Also report output-only and JVP-only cumulative spectral recovery and their minimum ranks for the absolute gates. These may use different bases and are lower bounds on the rank required by one joint basis.
basis_protocol.minimum_rank_scan: Evaluate integer ranks 1 through 768 algebraically from the frozen eigensystems; this is a descriptive capacity curve, not a candidate rank sweep.
basis_protocol.precision: float32 dense actions/JVPs and float64 covariance/eigendecomposition
basis_protocol.ridge_or_centering: none; use origin-through action subspaces because the complete experts are bias-free at their output

decision_rule.topology_write_pass: A topology passes the causal write necessary condition only if both discovery bases independently clear every absolute output, per-layer, per-expert, JVP, cross-bank action, occupancy, and finiteness gate on untouched heldout actions.
decision_rule.capacity_rejected: If its heldout same-split joint ceiling fails an absolute gate, close that topology at the registered rank as write-capacity insufficient.
decision_rule.identification_rejected: If same-split passes but causal bases fail, preserve the rank as representationally possible but require a separately preregistered causal functional metric/community estimator before any learned feature map.
decision_rule.feature_localized: If causal write gates pass, authorize only theory and preregistration of a feature-side nonlinear/JVP discriminator using the passing fixed write topology. Do not train a language model automatically.

systems.performance_gate: Foreground-poll the exact algebraic audit only if projected <=5 minutes; otherwise attach one verified @Codex terminal/error watcher immediately.
systems.callback_policy: Terminal success and actionable failure only for an expected one-to-two-hour audit; add a 90-minute resettable heartbeat only if measured or observed runtime exceeds two hours.
